business_problem: Bankers Healthcare Group needed to decouple legacy loan and product systems because traditional three-tier integrations were increasing cost, creating technical debt, and slowing the real-time product decisions required to keep up with growth.
solution_summary: BHG worked with Confluent Professional Services to build a streaming architecture that acts as the backbone of its modernization program. The company uses Kafka Connect and Confluent's pre-built connectors to pull data from business systems such as Salesforce, Elasticsearch, and New Relic into a shared streaming layer, where ksqlDB is being explored for transformations and enrichment. That architecture breaks through siloed connection layers, supports the company's move to Microsoft Azure, and gives product teams a common event backbone for analytics, marketing, loan, and auction workloads. Most importantly, it changes customer interactions from minutes-long backend processing to immediate product decisioning: as soon as a customer hits the stream, BHG can identify and present the most appropriate product offer. The same managed backbone also reduces integration effort from weeks to days and creates room for new product ideas instead of infrastructure churn.

solution_components.name: Kafka Connect

solution_components.name: ksqlDB
solution_components.role: Transforms and enriches streams as they move through emerging real-time use cases.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Consumes streamed credit-card and web-activity data as part of BHG's business strategy.

solution_components.name: Elasticsearch

data_flow: Credit-card, web-form, operational, and legacy-system data flows into Confluent through Kafka Connect, is transformed with ksqlDB where needed, and then moves to hubs and business systems such as Salesforce and Elasticsearch so BHG can drive faster product and customer decisions.
business_outcome: BHG reduced integration timelines from weeks to days, broke down data silos, accelerated cloud modernization, and enabled real-time product selection that supports faster growth and more innovative financial offerings.
